name: claude-ask
description: Use local Claude Code as a persistent full-access coding agent or independent second opinion from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run persistent Claude Code agents and follow-ups.
interface.longDescription: Adds persistent asynchronous Claude Code jobs with full-access workspace agents, resumable follow-ups, configurable effort and budgets, progress telemetry, job discovery, and structured diagnostics.
defaultPrompt: Ask Sonnet for a quick independent opinion without repository tools.
Ask Claude to investigate and fix this issue, then run the tests.
Ask Opus for an independent review of this implementation.
Continue the previous Claude job with a focused follow-up.
